items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote October 28
items.text: Serenity and peace of mind are a direct result of accepting our lives as they are at this moment, and all the money in the world cannot purchase this kind of peace.
items.attribution: “From Rags to Riches,” Cornwall, Ontario, January 2005, Voices of Long-Term Sobriety

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Octubre 28
items.text: Cuando amamos, vemos en los demás lo que querríamos ver en nosotros mismos.
items.source: Lo mejor del Grapevine, Volumen III
